# VeriWorkly Studio — Workspace & Document Builder
> The core authenticated web application and local-first canvas for building ATS-optimized resumes, cover letters, Master Profile data management, AI writing assistance, and API key self-service.

## Workspace Overview & Architecture
VeriWorkly Studio (`app.veriworkly.com`) is engineered around a **local-first storage architecture**. Documents are written to the browser's localStorage instantly without requiring login. Authenticated users benefit from automatic background cloud sync to PostgreSQL with optimistic concurrency, conflict detection, and offline editing support.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- **Agent Card**: `https://app.veriworkly.com/.well-known/agent.json`
- **OpenAPI Spec**: `https://app.veriworkly.com/openapi.json`
- **Pricing & Credit Ledger**: `https://app.veriworkly.com/pricing.md`
- **API Reference**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/docs/api-reference`

## Application Modules & Key Routes
- **Document Dashboard** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/` & `/documents`): List and grid views of resumes and cover letters with recency sorting, tag filtering, sync status indicators (local/pending/synced/conflicted), and global `Cmd/Ctrl+K` command palette.
- **Resume Editor** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/editor/[id]`): Section-based document canvas with live paged PDF preview. Supports 7 templates:
  - `executive-clarity` (Executive Clarity)
  - `precision-ats` (Precision ATS)
  - `modern-minimal` (Modern Minimal)
  - `timeline-focus` (Timeline Focus)
  - `corporate-brief` (Corporate Brief)
  - `bold-impact` (Bold Impact)
  - `veriworkly-special` (VeriWorkly Special)
- **Cover Letter Editor**: Dedicated cover letter canvas supporting 5 templates: `professional`, `veriworkly-special`, `minimalist`, `executive`, and `ats-essential`.
- **Master Profile Store** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/profile/master` & `/profile/advanced`): Single canonical career profile holding all career facts. New documents seed automatically from Master Profile without overwriting canonical data.
- **ATS Checker Workspace** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/ats`): Rule-based ATS readiness scoring (length, structure, action verbs, formatting risks) and AI-powered job description keyword match analysis.
- **Import Hub**: OAuth-based GitHub profile/repository ingestor (maps repos to projects deterministically) and AI-parsed LinkedIn profile text ingestor.
- **AI Writing Assistant**: Embedded "Improve with AI" controls supporting Standard and Expert credit modes for section rewriting, bullet generation, job tailoring, and cover letter drafting.
- **Export Dispatcher**: Type-driven multi-format exporter supporting PDF (`@react-pdf/renderer`), DOCX (`docx`), HTML, Markdown, Plain Text, and JSON.
- **Developer API Key Portal** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/api-keys`): Issue, rotate, scope-gate, and revoke `vw_` prefixed API keys.
- **Credits & Billing** (`https://app.veriworkly.com/credits` & `/billing`): AI credit wallet, FIFO grant allocation ledger, checkout via Dodo Payments, and subscription management.

## Guidance for AI Agents & Assistants
1. **Master Profile Operations**: Read `/api/v1/profiles/master` to retrieve baseline user career data before generating documents.
2. **ATS Rules Engine**: Use the deterministic rules engine (`/api/v1/ats/check`) for fast, zero-credit structural scoring.
3. **Credit Awareness**: Check credit balances (`/api/v1/billing/credits`) before invoking AI generation endpoints.
4. **Document Scoping**: Do not attempt to generate formal letters or invoices — resumes and cover letters are the two document types currently supported.
